status: frozen proposal for independent acceptance; not approved execution and not an implemented trainer
scope: One controlled transition-only repair experiment in a new version. Does not complete or change original HULC guide criteria.
rationale: Old place intent target was not forwarded to executor; missing held_closed place rejection coverage exists in unused AB/C real data; current readout also has held_closed errors.

action_contract.place: place_in_drawer() without object parameter; action target bits 4:7 all zero for every place sample and search option
action_contract.lift: keep three named colour actions and their object target bits
action_contract.posthold: preserve recorded 0/96 bit for old data; extra matched and online96; no GT-fill targets

initialization: Each arm starts from the identical corresponding v1 interaction selected model and query head. Preserve entire original files read-only.
freeze: shared semantic query head and thresholds
trainable: Only shared object/scene transition parameters; no new symbolic labels or feasibility classifier.

arms.canonical_control: Original AB888 pairs; auxiliary samples from original AB place pairs.
arms.canonical_matched: Same original AB888 pairs plus 12 pre-existing matched place pairs on4 additional AB roots; auxiliary samples only from these12. Common canonical interface in both arms.

sampler.base: Precompute same root-uniform AB indices and observed chains for each seed and both arms.
sampler.control_aux: Root-uniform original AB place, then uniform pair in root.
sampler.matched_aux: Uniform among4 AB roots, then among its3 collected branches; no condition values enter input/loss.
sampler.save: Persist complete pair-index/chain schedule before first optimizer update. No D/GT-dependent sampling.

loss: Reuse v1 equal4-group changed-weighted after-observation loss plus0.25 stopgrad real-successor latent MSE. Every4 updates same common-base observed2/3-step terms at0.25 each. Current reconstruction and variance omitted as constants under frozen representation. No zero-delta target imposed on refusals; use recorded actual after including96 hold.
selection: Per arm/seed choose minimum0.5*(old C35-root-macro changed-weighted observation MSE)+0.5*(additional C2-root-macro same MSE), checkpoints0/250/500/750/1000; earlier checkpoint breaks exact tie. Never use D1, D2, semantic scores or closed-loop success for selection.
development_reporting: Report both terms, every condition, all current/actual-successor/predicted-successor semantic denominators, normal-call regressions and refusal false-positive rate. Current readout is frozen and known imperfect; no hidden head calibration.

test.preparation: Each branch reset to same declared root. Real existing PhysicalOracle preparation; GT can verify/score preparation but never enter model or planner. Keep every failed preparation and root denominator, no replacement root. Preparation calls logged separately.
test.offline: Both seeds on same stored true before/after windows; all90 planned calls stratified into success/refused/failed/unreached with exact denominators.
test.closed_loop: Both arms seed0 only;12 matched roots each; max6 calls/rollout,24 rollouts,at most144 task calls. No stored reference sequence used by search.
test.planner: Same beam32,horizon4,threshold0.8,reobserve each call,max6; options differ only by canonical place. Record selected action and actual native contract; no hard-coded preconditions/effects.
test.no_test_repair: D1 used historical evidence only. D2 collect once after accepted implementation, no tuning/reselection/extra seeds/failure-specific retries after opening. Root-level paired reporting; do not treat branches/windows as independent.

acceptance_boundary: Independent protocol acceptance and code/data/interface audit precede any optimizer update or D2 collection. No numerical original-guide threshold is changed. Report a failed repair as a failure; no guaranteed improvement or complete-project claim.
known_limits: Freezing encoder/head cannot repair current-state HeldClosed query errors.
The matched AB coverage adds only4 independent roots; C adds2 and lacks red.
This compares extra coverage under a common corrected interface; it does not isolate interface correction against v1 on the same new test.
Closed-loop seed1 is not scheduled; no claim of across-seed closed-loop reproducibility.
